messages.author: 39f0839e8d6a4470
messages.subject: Distance 7 Beta 3
parts:
Hello all,

I would like to announce the release of Distance 7 Beta 3.
It can be downloaded from the distance sampling website:

http://distancesampling.org/Distance/distance70Beta3download.html

It has an improved simulation setup interface and is more stable than the alpha release.

Best wishes,

Laura
 
Dr. L. Marshall
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews

Dear Dr. Marshall,
Thank you for sharing the 7.3 beta version of Distance, which would be very useful.  I have just downloaded it and going to try it for ungulates, birds, plants and so on here in Saudi Arabia.

Thank you and best wishes.
Zafar
Director, Field Research
National Wildlife Research Center, Saudi Arabia
